description: Standing Cline schedules mirrored from Cam goals (nullboiler-compatible)

schedules.name: Cam nightly PA health
schedules.prompt: Run python3 scripts/connectome-check.py, then python3 scripts/sync-cline-session.py export --out /tmp/mesh-cline.json. Summarize PASS/FAIL and any missing edges. Do not push commits.

schedules.name: Cam weekly mesh distill
schedules.prompt: Review identity/persistence/cline-session-cache.json and vault/10-Mesh-Distillates for stale coding notes. Propose a short weekly distillate for mesh/cline. Do not invent Aaron personal facts.

schedules.name: Cam nightly MemoryBear doctor
schedules.prompt: Run python3 scripts/memorybear-check.py and python3 scripts/memorybear.py --doctor --offline. Summarize PASS/FAIL. If MEMORYBEAR_API_KEY is set, also run a live --doctor without --offline. Do not invent Aaron personal facts or push commits.

schedules.name: Cline submodule doctor
schedules.prompt: If this is a populated Cline checkout, run bun run cli doctor (or cline doctor) and summarize health. If submodule is empty, report that and stop.

schedules.name: Cam daily Needs Attention sweep
schedules.prompt: Run python3 scripts/needs-attention-check.py then python3 scripts/needs-attention.py --connect --dispatch-plan --write. Summarize connected/disconnected coding workspaces and the attention queue. Auto-clear only non-Aaron-gated items via choose-workspace routing notes; do not outbound-message, spend money, or apply Cam enhance. Do not push commits unless Aaron asked.
